evidence: Wired the end-to-end functional smoke through tdw-service-api -> tdw-runtime -> tdw-provider-fileset and persisted the OBBject roundtrip via tdw-storage-fs::LocalBlobEngine. Added tdw_test_utils::smoke::run_end_to_end_smoke library entry, two integration tests in crates/tdw-test-utils/tests/end_to_end_smoke.rs (AAPL happy path + symbol-normalization), unit test in the smoke module, and rewired tdw-service + tdw-cli binaries to invoke the smoke and emit a structured SmokeReport (JSON for tdw-service, one-line summary for tdw-cli). Documented the recipe at docs/quality/end-to-end-smoke.md and captured a transcript at docs/quality/end-to-end-smoke-transcript.md. Appended a Smoke Evidence (G009) section to each of the 9 participating crate readiness worksheets. Local verification: cargo test -p tdw-test-utils --all-targets passed 5/5 under RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable (workstation 1.95.0 toolchain is wedged by an unrelated rustc_driver DLL conflict and a parallel-session fs lock blocking uninstall; CI runs on clean 1.95.0).

message: Attempt 1

First slice landed: tdw-storage-postgres gets real PgEngine (sqlx 0.9 PgPool) behind --features postgres. Default in-memory engine preserved. Integration test gated by TDW_POSTGRES_TEST_URL. Doc + tracking matrix at docs/quality/production-storage-transports.md. Remaining: S3, ClickHouse, Qdrant, Meilisearch backends + CI wiring.

Second slice landed: tdw-storage-s3 gets real S3Engine (aws-sdk-s3 + aws-config) behind --features s3. from_env and from_endpoint constructors (path-style addressing for MinIO/R2). Integration test double-gated by feature + TDW_S3_TEST_BUCKET/TDW_S3_TEST_ENDPOINT. Updated docs/quality/production-storage-transports.md with S3 section and MinIO docker recipe. Remaining: ClickHouse, Qdrant, Meilisearch backends + CI wiring.

CI wiring: Integration job now starts postgres + minio (via docker-compose.yaml full profile), waits for health, creates the MinIO test bucket, and runs the feature-gated integration tests for tdw-storage-postgres and tdw-storage-s3 with appropriate TDW_*_TEST_* env vars. Turns the offline-by-default feature-gated tests into actually-running CI validation. Depends on PRs #13 (postgres) and #14 (s3) being merged.

Fourth slice landed: tdw-storage-qdrant gets QdrantHttpEngine via reqwest direct HTTP behind --features qdrant. Lazy collection auto-create on first upsert using the vector dimension and per-instance ensured-set cache. with_distance(Cosine|Dot|Euclid) builder override. Integration test double-gated by feature + TDW_QDRANT_TEST_URL exercises 3-point upsert + kNN search. reqwest declared as direct dep version 0.12.24 (PR #17 adds it to workspace.dependencies; once that lands a follow-up can switch this crate to workspace = true). Remaining storage backend: Meilisearch.

Third slice landed: tdw-storage-clickhouse gets ClickHouseHttpEngine via reqwest direct HTTP (no SDK) behind --features clickhouse. Uses ClickHouse's native HTTP interface with FORMAT JSON response parsing. Integration test double-gated by feature + TDW_CLICKHOUSE_TEST_URL. Also added reqwest to workspace.dependencies for downstream G011/G012 reuse. Remaining: Qdrant, Meilisearch backends + extending CI wiring.

G010 doc + CI extension: extended docs/quality/production-storage-transports.md with ClickHouse, Qdrant, Meilisearch sections + docker run recipes; extended .github/workflows/ci.yml to bring up clickhouse + qdrant + meilisearch alongside postgres + minio and run the feature-gated integration tests for all five backends. Status table now reflects 5/5 storage backends real. This PR closes out G010 fully.

First G013 slice landed: tdw-outbox gets PgOutboxStore backed by tdw-storage-postgres::PgEngine (no direct sqlx use), behind --features postgres. Single-table schema with BIGSERIAL sequence + JSONB envelope + status. append uses CTE WITH inserted AS (INSERT RETURNING) SELECT FROM inserted so PgEngine::fetch_json's row_to_json wrapping works. mark_dispatched + pending_after match InMemoryOutbox semantics exactly. Integration test double-gated by feature + TDW_POSTGRES_TEST_URL. Builds on the G010 storage foundation.

Second G013 slice landed: tdw-snapshot gets PgSnapshotStore backed by tdw-storage-postgres::PgEngine, behind --features postgres. Single-table schema with (table_name, version) UNIQUE constraint; commit computes next version server-side via COALESCE(MAX(version),0)+1 in a CTE-wrapped INSERT...SELECT...RETURNING. Concurrent writers serialise via the UNIQUE constraint. Integration test exercises monotonic versioning across two tables. Builds on the G010 storage foundation.

Third G013 slice: tdw-bus gets PgEventBus on top of PgEngine. publish/read_from/retention_window. Capacity-based eviction left to out-of-band housekeeping. Integration test double-gated by feature + TDW_POSTGRES_TEST_URL.

Fourth G013 slice: tdw-session gets PgSessionStore on top of PgEngine. Core session CRUD only (upsert + get) - permission rules + approvals + cost-ledger remain sqlite-backed for now and become follow-ups. Coexists with the existing SqliteSessionStore. Integration test double-gated by feature + TDW_POSTGRES_TEST_URL exercises upsert + get + conflict-update preserves created_at + None for unknown.

Fifth G013 slice (extends PR #25): tdw-session PgSessionStore expanded from CRUD-only to full SqliteSessionStore mirror - save/load permission_rules, request/resolve/pending approval, append_cost/cost_entries. Four-table schema (sessions + permission_state + pending_approvals + cost_ledger) with base-name prefix from with_table. Integration test exercises the full surface in one hermetic per-process roundtrip. Data warehouse scope (G010 + G013) now structurally complete - only #19 (G010 Meilisearch) and this expanded #25 remain in queue.

First G012 slice landed: tdw-llm-anthropic gets a real AnthropicHttpClient against POST /v1/messages behind --features http. Async-native (existing sync LanguageModel trait kept untouched). System messages fold into Anthropic's top-level system field; user/assistant in messages[]; tool turns fold into user with [tool] prefix (full tool-use envelope is a follow-up). Streaming SSE deferred to follow-up. Highest user-visible payoff in the session: the workspace can now actually talk to Claude in production.

Fifth and final G010 storage backend landed: tdw-storage-meilisearch gets MeilisearchHttpEngine via reqwest direct HTTP behind --features meilisearch. Index uses primaryKey=id with /tasks polling so callers can immediately follow index() with search_text() without flakiness. showRankingScore=true populates ScoredDoc.score. Integration test double-gated by feature + TDW_MEILISEARCH_TEST_URL exercises 3-doc index + text search. G010 storage backends now 5/5: Postgres + S3 + ClickHouse + Qdrant + Meilisearch. Remaining G010 work: extend production-storage-transports.md + CI workflow to cover ClickHouse + Qdrant + Meilisearch.

message: First G011 slice landed: tdw-provider-yahoo gets a real YahooHttpEquityHistoricalFetcher via reqwest direct HTTP behind --features http. Hits Yahoo's v8 chart endpoint (unauthenticated for delayed equity historical), parses the chart envelope, skips null bars, converts timestamps via inline Civil-from-Days. Cassette tests run by default under the feature; live test gated by TDW_YAHOO_LIVE=1. Existing synthetic YahooEquityHistoricalFetcher preserved for offline workspace tests. Pattern (feature-gated real HTTP fetcher + recorded cassette + opt-in live test) is the template for the remaining G011 providers (FRED, Alpaca, Binance, Polygon, HuggingFace).

Second G011 slice prepared: tdw-provider-fred gets FredHttpSeriesObservationsFetcher via reqwest direct HTTP behind --features http. It calls FRED /series/observations with FRED_API_KEY from the environment, parses JSON observations into FredObservation rows, skips missing-value '.' observations, and propagates FRED error envelopes. Cassette tests run under the feature; live test gated by TDW_FRED_LIVE=1 plus FRED_API_KEY. Yahoo and FRED are now the landed/ready provider transport patterns; remaining G011 providers are Alpaca, Binance, Polygon, and HuggingFace.

Third G011 slice prepared: tdw-provider-polygon gets PolygonHttpAggregatesFetcher via reqwest direct HTTP behind --features http. It calls Polygon /v2/aggs/ticker/{ticker}/range/1/day/{from}/{to} with POLYGON_API_KEY from the environment, parses aggregates into tdw_domain::MarketDataBar rows, validates ticker/date path components, and propagates Polygon error envelopes. Cassette tests run under the feature; live test gated by TDW_POLYGON_LIVE=1 plus POLYGON_API_KEY. Remaining G011 providers are Alpaca, Binance, and HuggingFace.

Fourth G011 slice prepared: tdw-provider-alpaca gets AlpacaHttpStockBarsFetcher via reqwest direct HTTP behind --features http. It calls Alpaca /v2/stocks/bars with APCA_API_KEY_ID and APCA_API_SECRET_KEY from the environment, parses per-symbol bars into tdw_domain::MarketDataBar rows, validates symbol/date/timeframe/feed query components, and propagates Alpaca error envelopes. Cassette tests run under the feature; live test gated by TDW_ALPACA_LIVE=1 plus Alpaca credentials. Remaining G011 providers are Binance and HuggingFace.
